amount/maxSectorAmount introduces sector-size/composition bias and a cross-sector denominator externality

RS influences ordering inside PriorityScore and again as the final deployed tie-break
zero market-relative performance contributes 50/100 to the component, i.e. 7 PriorityScore points
the component saturates at <=-25% and >=+25% relative return while raw relativeStrength can still differentiate ties outside/inside saturation depending on stored raw value
